@@U02533@@
“To whom it may concern,
hereby be advised that this note is worth
one thousand crowns, its collateral guaranteed
by countless treasures lying buried in Imperial Lands.
Plans are presently in motion to raise said treasure
and with it redeem this note.”

@@U02535@@
What is this I suspect?
Fraud?
Some monstrous deception?

@@U02537@@
Consider, Sire! Remember!
You signed it yourself, last night.
There you were, dressed as Great Pan,
and the Chancellor, in company with us,
approached you and said:
“Sign this note, Majesty,
and with a few strokes of the pen
crown this grand festivity
with salvation for your people!”
And sign it you did, Sire, and in the night
our nimble conjurors ran off thousands.
And to allow everyone without delay
to share in the benefit,
we at once stamped the whole series
Tens, thirties, fifties, hundreds
are now ready to hand.
You can't imagine the pleasure your subjects feel!
Take a look at your city.
It was dead and rotting before,
but now it’s alive and teeming with pleasure seekers!
Your name has always meant happiness,
but never has it been regarded with such devotion.
The alphabet lost its value last night,
for in this signature all men find happiness!
translation:
@@U02533@@
“对于可能关心的人来说，
特此通知，此注释值得
一千克朗，其抵押品有保证
帝国土地上埋藏着无数的宝藏。
目前正在制定筹集上述宝藏的计划
并用它兑换这张票据。”

@@U02535@@
我怀疑这是什么？
欺诈罪？
一些可怕的欺骗？

@@U02537@@
请考虑一下，陛下！记住！
昨晚你自己签了字。
你在那里，打扮成大潘，
校长和我们一起，
走近你并说道：
“签署这张纸条，陛下，
并用笔轻轻几笔
为这盛大的节日加冕
拯救你的人民！”
陛下，您已经签署了，就在晚上
我们灵活的魔术师逃走了数千人。
并让大家毫不拖延
分享利益，
我们立即在整个系列上盖章
十、三十、五十、数百
现在已经准备好了。
你无法想象你的拍摄对象感受到的快乐！
看看你所在的城市。
之前已经死了、腐烂了
但现在它却生机勃勃，充满了寻欢作乐的人！
你的名字一直意味着幸福
但从来没有人如此热心地对待过它。
昨晚字母表失去了它的价值，
因为在这个签名中，所有男人都找到了幸福！
